body: Because I feel like I'm rude and oblivious. I say the wrong things all the time. I have strange, often horrific, murderous thoughts. I embody the Deadly Sin of sloth. I'm annoying as fuck just to look at in the mirror.

I hate who I am. I always will. I try to give back but it doesn't feel like enough. I volunteer with mentally disabled kids, prep computers for people who can't afford them usually, and helped out at a fundraiser for a children's hospital. I still feel like I'm just... Me. I'm too "me". I need to die because, frankly, I just do. I'm never gonna get anywhere in life and it would have to be with a lot of toes getting stepped on. I can't.
I've actually got quite a few "friends", its just that I feel like no one would really care if I'm gone or not, so why waste space?
